args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the most recent healthy production release; v2.3.0 was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback completed in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history and identified `v2.3.0` as the most recent healthy production release.
3. Attempted rollback to `v2.3.0`, but it was rejected — that version is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
4. Rolled back to `v2.2.9`, the most recent healthy production release that is not quarantined. Rollback completed successfully in all regions.
5. Opened incident **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.
